name: 49651 · Lake City, MI
findings: ZIP 49651 (Lake City) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49651 (Lake City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49651 (Lake City) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
